activity: Office data entry and document handling
rationale: Extension board L2xS3 (shock credible but rare in an office); prolonged sitting L3xS2. With admin-only controls sitting stays L2xS2=4 so residual is MODERATE not LOW (stricter than the earlier TODO guess). All hazards S<=3 so ACCEPTABLE once routine controls are verified.
engine_change_needed: Remove the S4 uplift on low-voltage office electrical; S<=3 Moderate = ACCEPTABLE with no ALARP label (round 2 A and B)

proposed_end_state_one_pass: ACCEPTABLE after routine controls are confirmed (0-2 recommendations)
rationale: Oily-floor slip L3xS3 (fracture credible) drives inherent; informational only. With baseline-only controls the Copilot should ask for routine controls (SOP, supervision, housekeeping schedule) instead of proposing 4 recommendations.
engine_change_needed: No recommendations for S<=3 hazards when controls are not captured; max 2 on low-severity entries (round 2 C)

activity: Routine safety walk-through by the shift in-charge
proposed_residual_pass1: MODERATE (4-6) only if the fixture controls include marked or segregated crossings and crane-bay exclusion
rationale: Pedestrian versus vehicle S4 is credible. MODERATE residual needs an existing engineering control (marked crossings barriers speed control). If the fixture has admin-only controls HIGH 8 is correct and this expectation should change.
engine_change_needed: Check fixture controls and whether existing engineering controls are credited. No rubric change if admin-only.

rationale: Step-stool or ladder rack access and falling items are serious but normally LTI-level (S3) below the plant work-at-height threshold. Residual L1xS3 with ladder inspection and no-overreach rule.
engine_change_needed: S3 for ladder or step-stool work below the plant work-at-height threshold; S4-S5 at or above it and at edges/openings/fragile surfaces

rationale: LPG leak or explosion is S5-capable with routine daily exposure so inherent Critical is expected and informational. Residual MODERATE with verified hose and regulator checks ventilation and leak detection; S5 so the ALARP checklist applies.
engine_change_needed: None

activity: Main gate security duty and vehicle checking
rationale: Low-speed truck movement at a controlled gate: fatal outcome credible but rare (L2). Ambient heat for gate duty is S3 so residual MODERATE with shade rest and water.
engine_change_needed: Ambient/outdoor heat S3; radiant close-range heat S4

activity: Tool room bench work and pedestal grinder
rationale: Wheel burst or contact S4 at L3 with no events. Guards work-rest gap and wheel inspection give L1xS4.
engine_change_needed: None

rationale: Recorded molten-metal events support L4 inherent. Existing controls reduce to L2xS5 and it stays HIGH until a further engineering control is added. Not softened because evidence exists.
engine_change_needed: None

activity: Hot metal ladle handling by EOT crane (JSL)
rationale: Hot metal over people is the classic residual-High activity. Under the JSL rule Moderate is not acceptable so the end state is a Plant Head override with a review date rather than endless controls. Cabin radiant heat is S3 and acceptable.
engine_change_needed: Heat rubric and conditional second recommendation so the entry reaches OVERRIDE

activity: Belt conveyor idler replacement under LOTO
rationale: Entanglement or unexpected energisation without LOTO is fatal and routine (L3). Inherent excludes LOTO and guarding; residual MODERATE assumes both are recorded.
engine_change_needed: Inherent likelihood L3 for S5 without evidence (round 2 F); confirm residual stays MODERATE after F

activity: Confined space entry into an acid storage tank
proposed_end_state_one_pass: TOLERABLE_ALARP after a second engineering control
rationale: Confined space without controls is fatal and likely. Existing permit and gas test leave descent and rescue open; one more engineering control (davit or retrieval line) is practical and closes it.
engine_change_needed: Round 2 F and D

rationale: Recorded height events and no real controls: the Copilot must ask for controls first. With edge protection lifelines crawling boards and permit it reaches ALARP. Contractor roof work cannot be waved through.

rationale: Die-area hazard S4 reduces to L1 with guards two-hand control and light curtain. Repetitive feeding is strain (S2) so residual L2xS2 with job rotation.

rationale: Disc burst and kickback S4 give HIGH inherent. Shock from a damaged cable is S5 but unlikely with RCD and cable checks. Sparks igniting combustibles is S3 unless flammables are indicated so residual MODERATE with hot-work permit and spark control.
engine_change_needed: Routine grinding or cutting sparks S3 unless flammable inventory is indicated

rationale: Recorded fire events support L4 inherent. Flashback arrestors hot-work permit and fire watch give HIGH residual; securing cut sections and hose management finish it.

activity: Air compressor and hydraulic power pack maintenance
rationale: Recorded pressure events support L4 for hydraulic injection (S4); air receiver rupture is S5. Depressurisation procedure and statutory receiver testing leave HIGH; hose whip restraints close it. Statutory test status must be captured.

activity: Tipper unloading at the RMHS ground hopper
